name: cirkuitnet/seocart
description: SEOCart is a free, open-source e-commerce plugin for WordPress.

extra.strauss-notes: Action Scheduler is copied into vendor-scoped/ but deliberately NEVER prefixed and never added to the generated classmap: its version negotiation across plugins depends on the real class names. Reviewed exception: docs/adr/ADR-0008-background-jobs-run-on-action-scheduler-bundled-unscoped-behind-a-port.md. Every other runtime library is prefixed. Strauss reads its configuration only from this file, so there is no strauss.json.

scripts.lint:php: parallel-lint --exclude .git --exclude vendor --exclude vendor-scoped --exclude node_modules --exclude build --exclude dist .

scripts-descriptions.lint:php: Checks every PHP file for syntax errors.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Runs PHP_CodeSniffer: WordPress Coding Standards, PHPCompatibilityWP and the SEOCart DRY sniffs.
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fixes the coding-standard violations that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.cs:dry: Runs only the SEOCart DRY and compliance sniffs.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Runs PHPStan at the level set in phpstan.neon.dist.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Runs the unit suite. WordPress is never loaded.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Runs the integration suite against WordPress and a real MySQL database.
scripts-descriptions.test:tools: Runs the self-tests for the custom sniffs and checkers in tools/.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fails when a generated document has drifted from its source, and prints the command that regenerates it.
scripts-descriptions.wporg:check: Runs the WordPress.org directory checks that do not need a built zip.
scripts-descriptions.licenses:check: Fails when a runtime dependency is not on the GPLv3-compatible licence allow-list.
scripts-descriptions.gates: Runs every gate that does not need a database or a browser.
scripts-descriptions.scope-vendor: Copies runtime dependencies into vendor-scoped/ with Strauss.
